DZA.note: Document is about land conservation offices, not customs.

facts.fact: Algeria's finance minister told the National People's Assembly on 12 December 2024 that digitising the land file, archives and documents in the land conservation offices has given automated, secured management of all land transactions.

DZA.note: The single window ordered in each office coordinates services; the source does not say it joins systems.

facts.fact: Algeria's finance minister said on 12 December 2024 that the land file and archives of the land conservation offices have been digitised, covering property status, real rights and owners.

DZA.note: Coverage of the whole country and online access are not stated.
